metadata.geographic_scope: Mangaluru city and nearby suburban corridors represented in the legacy project dataset
metadata.intended_use: Static route-pattern discovery and transfer planning after route and stop verification.
metadata.coverage_note: This is a structured migration and research baseline, not a certified inventory of all currently operating Mangaluru buses.
important_constraints: Only the direction represented by each listed stop sequence is stored. No reverse pattern is generated implicitly.
A route number appearing in a public directory is not proof that the service currently operates.
A route pattern is not a timetable or an individual trip.
No arrival times, frequencies, fares, travel durations, live locations, operator identities, or stop coordinates are asserted.
Do not treat legacy_endpoint_confidence as whole-route or current-service verification.

sources.title: Kudla Route project baseline data/busData.json
used_for: ordered stop sequences as previously stored
limitations: The previous project documentation states that intermediate stop sequences were not fully confirmed.
The previous dataset stores one ordered sequence per route and its planner assumed reverse operation; this new dataset does not make that assumption.
Historical high/medium/low confidence labels related to route-end matching and must not be interpreted as full route verification.
This source is a project baseline, not an operator or government source.

sources.title: Mangalore City Bus Routes & Numbers (2026)
used_for: Cross-checking whether a subset of route numbers appears in a public route directory.
limitations: The page describes its route list as adapted from public sources.
It is not an official operator feed or government GTFS dataset.
Route-number presence does not verify the exact stop sequence, current operation, operator, timetable, or reverse direction.
Some entries and route descriptions on the page are duplicated or inconsistent; use only as a weak secondary cross-check.

sources.title: Mangalore Bus Routes – All Private & City Bus Numbers
used_for: Contextual comparison of the claimed directory coverage (92 active scheduled routes).
limitations: The directory is not an official operator or government feed.
Its claim of 92 active scheduled routes is not treated as proof of route operation or complete coverage.
No route stop sequence is imported solely from the directory landing-page summary.

sources.title: Local Bus Routes – MangaluruBus
used_for: Cross-checking the existence of a broader set of local route-number labels.
limitations: The index lists route numbers but does not by itself verify complete stop sequences or current service.
Not an official operator or government source.

sources.title: KSRTC launches bus services from Mangaluru Junction Railway Station
used_for: Recording that a separate KSRTC service notice exists for Mangaluru Junction–Kateel, Bokkapatna, State Bank, and Kodikal services.
limitations: These are scheduled KSRTC services and must not be merged into private city-bus route-number patterns without operator/service identity and current timetable verification.
The notice is time-specific and does not establish that the same timetable remains active.
Not imported as an active route pattern in this dataset.
